verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Marlin generating reports and slides, and it lists Team and Enterprise plan tiers. Nothing documents sharing a research session or report with collaborators, or letting them view or build on it. Plan names and downloadable deliverables are adjacent at best, and Marlin Insights is Sakana's own published research, not a user sharing feature.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it
